def civil_to_days(y, m, d):
    adjusted_year = y - (1 if m <= 2 else 0)
    era = adjusted_year // 400
    year_of_era = adjusted_year - era * 400
    shifted_month = m + (-3 if m > 2 else 9)
    day_of_year = (153 * shifted_month + 2) // 5 + d - 1
    return era * 146097 + year_of_era * 365 + year_of_era // 4 - year_of_era // 100 + day_of_year
def days_to_civil(z):
    era = z // 146097
    day_of_era = z - era * 146097
    year_of_era = (day_of_era - day_of_era // 1460 + day_of_era // 36524 - day_of_era // 146096) // 365
    y = year_of_era + era * 400
    day_of_year = day_of_era - (365 * year_of_era + year_of_era // 4 - year_of_era // 100)
    shifted_month = (5 * day_of_year + 2) // 153
    d = day_of_year - (153 * shifted_month + 2) // 5 + 1
    m = shifted_month + (3 if shifted_month < 10 else -9)
    y += 1 if m <= 2 else 0
    return y, m, d
start_year, start_month, start_day = days_to_civil(civil_to_days(year, month, day) - 9)
